Title: C# UDF for Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge now in preview

Body.Content:
C# user-defined functions (UDF) support for Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge is now available in preview.

C# UDF allows you to extend the Azure Stream Analytics SQL language with your own functions, enabling you to reuse existing code, implement custom logic to manipulate complex strings, or run mathematical functions with complex logic. With the Visual Studio tool for Azure Stream Analytics, you can define and test your jobs locally—even when you’re offline—and then publish the Azure Stream Analytics jobs to Azure. Easily deploy the Azure Stream Analytics jobs to thousands of IoT devices using IoT Hub with just a few clicks.

Watch Azure Stream Analytics: Managing timelines and coding on IoT Edge.
